headline_seed: Nepal flash flood live updates: more than 1,000 people missing after glacial collapse at Tibet border - The Guardian
draft_text:
#BreakingMews Flash flood, Nepal-China border, Wednesday: Al Jazeera reports 165 dead, NBC News confirms at least 157. Hundreds of tourists missing, including 133 Indians on Kailash pilgrimage and 47 Americans.

And that's the mews.
